aliases.name: bt-all
aliases.description: Print full backtrace with all threads (requires 'thread apply' support).

aliases.name: sym-reload
aliases.description: Reload all shared libraries and re-read symbols.
aliases.body:
set sharedlibrary symbol-file-search-path
  shell ls /proc/$(pidof myapp)/maps 2>/dev/null
  symbol-file

vars.name: trace_enabled
vars.description: Flag used by custom tracing macros (set to 0 to disable tracing).
